paragraphs.text: Mandrake Nightshade was an evil black and red mage.
During the Great Magus War , he destroyed Martuk .

In his final battle on Mt. Margalus, he summoned several dragons and pit lords, only to fall at the hands of Selena Mistencharmer and Slides Stardust . This mountain has since become known as Mandrake's Mountain. Upon his death, Selena and Slides feared his possible resurrection, so they put a dangerous curse on the mountain that would drain anyone who set foot on the mountain.
